label: Venture Capital Fund Analytics
description: Fund-level VC analytics: portfolio construction and reserves/follow-on modelling, TVPI/DPI/RVPI and IRR, the J-curve, loss-ratio and power-law return concentration, and ILPA-aligned LP reporting.

claudeKnowledge.description: ILPA Reporting Template (Fee, Expense & Carried Interest) and ILPA Quarterly Reporting Standards; ILPA Performance / Capital Account guidance; GIPS 2020 (CFA Institute) for private-market composites and money-weighted return; IPEV Valuation Guidelines (Dec 2022) and IFRS 13 / IAS 28 fair-value basis; SFDR (EU) 2019/2088 fund disclosure where ESG is in scope; standard VC literature on power-law return distributions, reserve ratios and the J-curve.

guidedInputs.label: Fund stage / strategy
guidedInputs.description: What stage does the fund primarily invest at? Drives expected loss ratio, ownership target, and reserve intensity.

guidedInputs.label: Analysis focus
guidedInputs.description: Which fund-level questions should the analysis prioritise?

options.label: Portfolio construction (check size, ownership, # of companies)
Performance metrics (TVPI/DPI/RVPI, gross vs net IRR)
ILPA-aligned LP reporting (capital accounts, fees, carry)

guidedInputs.label: Fund lifecycle stage
guidedInputs.description: Where is the fund in its life? Determines whether metrics are forecast (model-driven) or realised (reporting-driven).

guidedInputs.label: Valuation / reporting basis
guidedInputs.description: Which valuation and reporting standards apply to the fund?

guidedInputs.label: Fund context, data & known concerns
guidedInputs.description: Describe the fund (size, vintage, # of portfolio companies, ownership targets, paid-in to date) and any known concerns about construction, pacing, marks, or LP-reporting gaps.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. EUR 80m seed fund, 2022 vintage, 30 cos targeted, ~12% entry ownership, 50% reserves. PIC EUR 34m, one EUR 6x markup carries the marks; concerned the J-curve looks worse than peers and our DPI is still 0.0x at year 3...

exampleInput: We manage an EUR 80m seed-stage fund (2022 vintage, EU/Nordic focus). Target portfolio: ~30 companies, EUR ~1.2m initial cheques at ~12% entry ownership, 50% of fund reserved for follow-ons. We are at the end of year 3: paid-in capital is EUR 34m, 19 initial investments made, one company marked up 6x (it is currently 55% of our gross NAV), three written off, the rest at or near cost. Net IRR is slightly negative and DPI is 0.0x — our LPs are asking whether the fund is tracking. Run a fund-level analytics review: pressure-test our portfolio construction and reserve ratio, compute and interpret TVPI/DPI/RVPI and gross vs net IRR with the J-curve in mind, assess the power-law / loss-ratio concentration risk in the current book, and tell us what an ILPA-aligned quarterly LP report should say about where we stand. Known concern: a single position dominates the marks and we have not yet deployed reserves at scale.

exampleValues.known_concerns: EUR 80m seed fund, 2022 vintage. PIC EUR 34m, 19 initial cheques, ~12% entry ownership, 50% reserves. One position is 6x and ~55% of gross NAV; 3 write-offs; DPI 0.0x at year 3; net IRR slightly negative. LPs asking if the fund is on track. Reserves largely undeployed.
